  have hvD : k + a n - a (n - 1) ≠ 0 → α ≤ padicValInt p (k + a n - a (n - 1)) := by
    intro hD0
    exact ((padicValInt_dvd_iff α (k + a n - a (n - 1))).mp hD).resolve_left hD0
  
  have hdiff : V ≠ V' → padicValRat p ((a (n - 1) : ℚ) - (a n : ℚ)) = min V V' := by
    intro hne
    have hne2 : (a (n - 1) : ℚ) + -(a n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← sub_eq_add_neg]
      intro hz
      apply hne
      have : a (n - 1) = a n := by exact_mod_cast sub_eq_zero.mp hz
      rw [hV, hV', this]
    have h1 : padicValRat p (a (n - 1) : ℚ) = V := by simp [hV]
    have h2 : padicValRat p (a n : ℚ) = V' := by simp [hV']
    have h3 : padicValRat p (a (n - 1) : ℚ) ≠ padicValRat p (-(a n : ℚ)) := by
      rw [padicValRat.neg, h1, h2]
      exact_mod_cast hne
    have hrw := padicValRat.add_eq_min hne2 (by exact_mod_cast han1)
      (neg_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast han)) h3
    rw [padicValRat.neg, h1, h2] at hrw
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Nat.cast_min]
    exact hrw
  have hdiff_int : V ≠ V' → padicValInt p (a (n - 1) - a n) = min V V' := by
    intro hne
    have h := hdiff hne
    rw [← Int.cast_sub, padicValRat.of_int] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro hlt
    have hVV : V < V' := by lia
    have hne : V ≠ V' := by lia
    rw [min_eq_left (by lia)] at hdiff_int
    have hkV : κ = V := by
      by_cases hD0 : k + a n - a (n - 1) = 0
      · have hke : k = a (n - 1) - a n := by lia
        rw [hκ, hke]
        exact hdiff_int hne
      · have hvD' := hvD hD0
        have hkDE : (k : ℚ) = ((k + a n - a (n - 1) : ℤ) : ℚ) + ((a (n - 1) - a n : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
          push_cast; ring
        have hqD : padicValRat p ((k + a n - a (n - 1) : ℤ) : ℚ) =
            padicValInt p (k + a n - a (n - 1)) := padicValRat.of_int
        have hqE : padicValRat p ((a (n - 1) - a n : ℤ) : ℚ) = V := by
          rw [padicValRat.of_int]; exact_mod_cast hdiff_int hne
        have hkne : ((k + a n - a (n - 1) : ℤ) : ℚ) + ((a (n - 1) - a n : ℤ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [← hkDE]; exact_mod_cast hk0
        by_cases hcase : padicValInt p (k + a n - a (n - 1)) = V
        · have hge := padicValRat.min_le_padicValRat_add (p := p) hkne
          rw [hqD, hqE, hcase, ← hkDE, padicValRat.of_int, ← hκ] at hge
          lia
        · have heq := padicValRat.add_eq_min (p := p) hkne (by exact_mod_cast hD0)
            (by exact_mod_cast sub_ne_zero.mpr (by
              intro he
              apply hne
              rw [hV, hV', he])) (by rw [hqD, hqE]; exact_mod_cast hcase)
          rw [hqD, hqE, ← hkDE, padicValRat.of_int, ← hκ] at heq
          lia
    exact ⟨hkV.symm, by lia⟩
  · 
    intro heq
    lia
  · 
    intro hgt
    have hVV : V' < V := by lia
    have hne : V ≠ V' := by lia
    rw [min_eq_right (by lia)] at hdiff_int
    have hV'α : α ≤ V' := by
      by_cases hD0 : k + a n - a (n - 1) = 0
      · have hke : a (n - 1) - a n = k := by lia
        have : padicValInt p (a (n - 1) - a n) = κ := by rw [hke, hκ]
        rw [hdiff_int hne] at this
        lia
      · have hvD' := hvD hD0
        have hDE : ((a (n - 1) - a n : ℤ) : ℚ) =
            (k : ℚ) - ((k + a n - a (n - 1) : ℤ) : ℚ) := by push_cast; ring
        have hqD : padicValRat p ((k + a n - a (n - 1) : ℤ) : ℚ) =
            padicValInt p (k + a n - a (n - 1)) := padicValRat.of_int
        have hqk : padicValRat p (k : ℚ) = κ := padicValRat.of_int
        have hne3 : (k : ℚ) - ((k + a n - a (n - 1) : ℤ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [← hDE]
          exact_mod_cast sub_ne_zero.mpr (by
            intro he
            apply hne
            rw [hV, hV', he])
        have hge := padicValRat.min_le_padicValRat_add (p := p) (q := (k : ℚ))
          (r := -((k + a n - a (n - 1) : ℤ) : ℚ)) (by rwa [sub_eq_add_neg] at hne3)
        rw [padicValRat.neg, hqD, hqk] at hge
        nth_rw 2 [Int.add_sub_assoc] at hge
        rw [Rat.intCast_add, Rat.neg_add, add_neg_cancel_left, ← Rat.intCast_neg, Int.neg_sub] at hge
        rw [padicValRat.of_int, hdiff_int hne] at hge
        have hmin : α ≤ min κ (padicValInt p (k + a n - a (n - 1))) := le_min (by lia) hvD'
        exact hmin.trans (by exact_mod_cast hge)
    exact ⟨by lia, hV'α⟩

name: bound
statement:
lemma bound (a : ℕ → ℤ) (apos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (h : ∀ n, N ≤ n → ∃ z : ℤ, z = S a n)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : N - 1 ≤ n) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    padicValInt p (a n) ≤ padicValInt p (a 0) + padicValInt p (a (N - 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact Nat.le_add_left _ _
  | succ n hn ih =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := step a apos N h (n := n + 1) (by lia) (by lia)
    obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := val_rule a apos hp hk1 hk2
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at c1 c2 c3
    rcases lt_trichotomy (padicValInt p k) (padicValInt p (a 0)) with hlt | heq | hgt
    · obtain ⟨-, e2⟩ := c1 hlt
      rw [e2]
      exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
    · rw [c2 heq]
      exact ih
    · obtain ⟨g1, -⟩ := c3 hgt
      lia

name: dvd_bound
statement:
lemma dvd_bound (a : ℕ → ℤ) (apos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (h : ∀ n, N ≤ n → ∃ z : ℤ, z = S a n) (n : ℕ) (hn : N - 1 ≤ n) :
    a n ∣ a 0 * a (N - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have key : (a n).natAbs ∣ (a 0 * a (N - 1)).natAbs := by
    rw [Int.natAbs_mul]
    rw [← Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr (apos n).ne')
      (mul_ne_zero (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr (apos 0).ne') (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr (apos (N - 1)).ne'))]
    intro p
    by_cases hp : p.Prime
    · rw [Nat.factorization_mul (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr (apos 0).ne')
        (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr (apos (N - 1)).ne'), Finsupp.add_apply,
        Nat.factorization_def _ hp, Nat.factorization_def _ hp, Nat.factorization_def _ hp]
      exact bound a apos N hN h n hn p hp
    · rw [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime _ hp,
        Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime _ hp]
  exact Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mp key

name: walk_const
statement:
lemma walk_const (a : ℕ → ℤ) (apos : ∀ n, 0 < a n) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (h : ∀ n, N ≤ n → ∃ z : ℤ, z = S a n)
    {n₁ n₂ : ℕ} (hn₁ : N ≤ n₁) (hlt : n₁ < n₂) (heq : a n₁ = a n₂)
    (j : ℕ) (hj1 : n₁ ≤ j) (hj2 : j ≤ n₂) : a j = a n₁
proof:
:= by
  
  have hkk : ∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, i ∈ Finset.Ioc n₁ n₂ →
      a i * k = a 0 * a (i - 1) ∧ a 0 ∣ k + a i - a (i - 1) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ Finset.Ioc n₁ n₂
    · have hi' := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hi
      obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := step a apos N h (n := i) (by lia) (by lia)
      exact ⟨k, fun _ => ⟨hk1, hk2⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨1, fun h' => absurd h' hi⟩
  choose! kk hkk using hkk
  
  have hkappa : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ∀ i ∈ Finset.Ioc n₁ n₂,
      padicValInt p (kk i) = padicValInt p (a 0) := by
    intro p hp
    
    have F : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Ioc n₁ n₂, padicValInt p (a 0) ≤ padicValInt p (a (i - 1)) →
        padicValInt p (a 0) ≤ padicValInt p (a i) := by
      intro i hi hprev
      obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := hkk i hi
      obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := val_rule a apos hp hk1 hk2
      rcases lt_trichotomy (padicValInt p (kk i)) (padicValInt p (a 0)) with hlt | heq | hgt
      · obtain ⟨e1, -⟩ := c1 hlt
        lia
      · rw [c2 heq]; exact hprev
      · exact (c3 hgt).2
    have Fgen : ∀ s ∈ Finset.Icc n₁ n₂, padicValInt p (a 0) ≤ padicValInt p (a s) →
        ∀ m, s + m ≤ n₂ → padicValInt p (a 0) ≤ padicValInt p (a (s + m)) := by
      intro s hs hα m
      induction m with
      | zero => intro _; exact hα
      | succ m ihm =>
        intro hm
        have hmem : s + (m + 1) ∈ Finset.Ioc n₁ n₂ := by
          have := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hs
          rw [Finset.mem_Ioc]
          lia
        have hprev : padicValInt p (a 0) ≤ padicValInt p (a (s + (m + 1) - 1)) := by
          rw [Nat.add_succ_sub_one]
          exact ihm (by lia)
        exact F (s + (m + 1)) hmem hprev
    
    have hsplit : (∀ i ∈ Finset.Icc n₁ n₂, padicValInt p (a 0) ≤ padicValInt p (a i)) ∨
        (∀ i ∈ Finset.Icc n₁ n₂, padicValInt p (a i) < padicValInt p (a 0)) := by
      by_cases hall : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Icc n₁ n₂, padicValInt p (a 0) ≤ padicValInt p (a i)
      · exact Or.inl hall
      · right
        push Not at hall
        obtain ⟨j₁, hj₁mem, hj₁⟩ := hall
        intro i himem
        by_contra! hcon
        have h1 : padicValInt p (a 0) ≤ padicValInt p (a n₂) := by
          have hgi := Fgen i himem hcon (n₂ - i) (by have := Finset.mem_Icc.mp himem; lia)
          rwa [Nat.add_sub_of_le <| Finset.mem_Icc.mp himem |>.right] at hgi
        have h2 : padicValInt p (a 0) ≤ padicValInt p (a n₁) := by rwa [← heq] at h1
        have h3 : padicValInt p (a 0) ≤ padicValInt p (a j₁) := by
          have hgi := Fgen n₁ (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; lia) h2 (j₁ - n₁)
            (by have := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj₁mem; lia)
          rwa [Nat.add_sub_of_le <| Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj₁mem |>.left] at hgi
        lia
    rcases hsplit with hall | hall
    · 
      have T : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Ioc n₁ n₂, padicValInt p (a i) ≤ padicValInt p (a (i - 1)) := by
        intro i hi
        obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := hkk i hi
        obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := val_rule a apos hp hk1 hk2
        rcases lt_trichotomy (padicValInt p (kk i)) (padicValInt p (a 0)) with hlt | heq | hgt
        · obtain ⟨e1, -⟩ := c1 hlt
          have := hall (i - 1) (by have := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hi; rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; lia)
          lia
        · rw [c2 heq]
        · exact (c3 hgt).1.le
      have hupper : ∀ m, n₁ + m ≤ n₂ → padicValInt p (a (n₁ + m)) ≤ padicValInt p (a n₁) := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero => intro _; exact le_rfl
        | succ m ihm =>
          intro hm
          have hmem : n₁ + (m + 1) ∈ Finset.Ioc n₁ n₂ := by rw [Finset.mem_Ioc]; lia
          have hle := T (n₁ + (m + 1)) hmem
          rw [Nat.add_succ_sub_one] at hle
          exact le_trans hle (ihm (by lia))
      have hlower : ∀ m, n₁ ≤ n₂ - m → padicValInt p (a n₂) ≤ padicValInt p (a (n₂ - m)) := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero => intro _; exact le_rfl
        | succ m ihm =>
          intro hm
          have hmem : n₂ - m ∈ Finset.Ioc n₁ n₂ := by rw [Finset.mem_Ioc]; lia
          have hle := T (n₂ - m) hmem
          rw [Nat.sub_sub] at hle
          exact le_trans (ihm (by lia)) hle
      have hVeq : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Icc n₁ n₂, padicValInt p (a i) = padicValInt p (a n₁) := by
        intro i hi
        rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hi
        have hu := hupper (i - n₁) (by lia)
        rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le <| hi.left] at hu
        have hl := hlower (n₂ - i) (by lia)
        rw [Nat.sub_sub_self <| hi.right, ← heq] at hl
        exact le_antisymm hu hl
      intro i hi
      obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := hkk i hi
      obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := val_rule a apos hp hk1 hk2
      rcases lt_trichotomy (padicValInt p (kk i)) (padicValInt p (a 0)) with hlt | heq | hgt
      · obtain ⟨e1, -⟩ := c1 hlt
        have hge := hall (i - 1) (by have := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hi; rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; lia)
        lia
      · exact heq
      · obtain ⟨g1, -⟩ := c3 hgt
        have e1 := hVeq i (by have := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hi; rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; lia)
        have e2 := hVeq (i - 1) (by have := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hi; rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; lia)
        lia
    · 
      intro i hi
      obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := hkk i hi
      obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := val_rule a apos hp hk1 hk2
      rcases lt_trichotomy (padicValInt p (kk i)) (padicValInt p (a 0)) with hlt | heq | hgt
      · obtain ⟨-, e2⟩ := c1 hlt
        have hlt' := hall i (by have := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hi; rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; lia)
        lia
      · exact heq
      · obtain ⟨-, g2⟩ := c3 hgt
        have hlt' := hall i (by have := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hi; rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; lia)
        lia
  
  have hkk_eq : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Ioc n₁ n₂, kk i = a 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hpos_k : 0 < kk i := by
      obtain ⟨hk1, -⟩ := hkk i hi
      exact pos_of_mul_pos_right (by rw [hk1]; exact mul_pos (apos 0) (apos _)) (apos i).le
    have hfac : (kk i).natAbs = (a 0).natAbs := by
      apply Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hpos_k.ne')
        (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr (apos 0).ne')
      intro p
      by_cases hp : p.Prime
      · rw [Nat.factorization_def _ hp, Nat.factorization_def _ hp]
        exact hkappa p hp i hi
      · rw [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime _ hp, Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime _ hp]
    have e1 : ((kk i).natAbs : ℤ) = kk i := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hpos_k.le
    have e2 : ((a 0).natAbs : ℤ) = a 0 := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (apos 0).le
    rw [← e1, ← e2, hfac]
  
  have hstay : ∀ i ∈ Finset.Ioc n₁ n₂, a i = a (i - 1) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨hk1, -⟩ := hkk i hi
    rw [hkk_eq i hi, mul_comm (a i) (a 0)] at hk1
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (apos 0).ne' hk1
  
  have hfinal : ∀ m, n₁ + m ≤ n₂ → a (n₁ + m) = a n₁ := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro _; rfl
    | succ m ihm =>
      intro hm
      have hmem : n₁ + (m + 1) ∈ Finset.Ioc n₁ n₂ := by rw [Finset.mem_Ioc]; lia
      rw [hstay (n₁ + (m + 1)) hmem, Nat.add_succ_sub_one]
      exact ihm (by lia)
  have := hfinal (j - n₁) (by lia)
  rwa [Nat.add_sub_of_le hj1] at this

name: feq
statement: theorem feq (a b c : ℝ) : f a b c = a^2 + b^2 + c^2 + a * b * c
proof: := rfl

name: geq
statement: theorem geq (a b c : ℝ) : g a b c = a * b + b * c + c * a - a * b * c
proof: := rfl

name: usa2001_p3_lemma
statement:
lemma usa2001_p3_lemma (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (h : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + a * b * c = 4)
    (hbc : (b - 1) * (c - 1) ≥ 0) :
    a * b + b * c + c * a - a * b * c ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have eq1 := calc
    (2 + a) * (2 - a) = 4 - a ^ 2 := by ring_nf
    _ = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + a * b * c - a ^ 2 := by rw [h]
    _ = (b ^ 2 + c ^ 2) + a * b * c := by ring_nf
    _ ≥ 2 * b * c + a * b * c := by rel [two_mul_le_add_sq b c]
    _ = (2 + a) * (b * c) := by ring_nf
  have a2gt0 : 2 + a > 0 := by linarith
  have bc := (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ a2gt0).mp eq1
  calc
    a * b + b * c + c * a - a * b * c = a * b + b * c + a * c * (1 - b) := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ a * b + (2 - a) + a * c * (1 - b) := by gcongr
    _ = 2 - a * ((b - 1) * (c - 1)) := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ 2 - 0 := by gcongr; positivity
    _ = 2 := by norm_num

name: M_pos
statement: lemma M_pos (a : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) : 0 < M a N
proof:
:=
  Nat.add_one_pos _

name: one_le_M
statement: lemma one_le_M (a : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) : 1 ≤ M a N
proof:
:=
  Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le.1 (M_pos a N)

name: apply_lt_M_of_le_N
statement: lemma apply_lt_M_of_le_N (a : ℕ → ℕ) {N i : ℕ} (h : i ≤ N) : a i < M a N
proof:
:=
  Nat.lt_add_one_iff.2 (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.2 h))

name: N_lt_of_M_le_apply
statement: lemma N_lt_of_M_le_apply {a : ℕ → ℕ} {N i : ℕ} (h : M a N ≤ a i) : N < i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hi
  exact Nat.not_succ_le_self _ (h.trans (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.2 hi)))

name: ne_zero_of_M_le_apply
statement: lemma ne_zero_of_M_le_apply {a : ℕ → ℕ} {N i : ℕ} (h : M a N ≤ a i) : i ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  Nat.ne_zero_of_lt (N_lt_of_M_le_apply h)

name: apply_lt_of_M_le_apply
statement:
lemma apply_lt_of_M_le_apply {a : ℕ → ℕ} {N i j : ℕ} (hi : M a N ≤ a i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    a j < a i
proof:
:=
  (apply_lt_M_of_le_N a hj).trans_le hi

name: apply_ne_of_M_le_apply
statement:
lemma apply_ne_of_M_le_apply {a : ℕ → ℕ} {N i j : ℕ} (hi : M a N ≤ a i) (hj : j ≤ N) :
    a j ≠ a i
proof:
:=
  (apply_lt_of_M_le_apply hi hj).ne

name: toFinset_card_pos
statement: lemma toFinset_card_pos {a : ℕ → ℕ} {i : ℕ} (hf : {j | a j = a i}.Finite) : 0 < #hf.toFinset
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_pos.mpr ((Set.Finite.toFinset_nonempty _).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: apply_nth_zero
statement: lemma apply_nth_zero (a : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) : a (Nat.nth (a · = a i) 0) = a i
proof:
:=
  Nat.nth_mem (p := (a · = a i)) 0 toFinset_card_pos

name: map_add_one_range
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_map]
  constructor
  · aesop
  · intro hx
    use x - 1
    cases x <;> simp_all

name: pos
statement: protected lemma pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < a n
proof: := hc.1 n

name: apply_ne_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma apply_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : a n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (hc.pos _).ne'

name: one_le_apply
statement: lemma one_le_apply (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ a n
proof:
:=
  Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (hc.apply_ne_zero n)

name: apply_eq_card
statement: lemma apply_eq_card {n : ℕ} (h : N < n) : a n = #{i ∈ Finset.range n | a i = a (n - 1)}
proof:
:=
  hc.2 n h

name: apply_add_one_eq_card
statement:
lemma apply_add_one_eq_card {n : ℕ} (h : N ≤ n) :
    a (n + 1) = #{i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1) | a i = a n}
proof:
:= by
  rw [hc.apply_eq_card (Nat.lt_add_one_of_le h)]
  simp

name: nth_apply_eq_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma nth_apply_eq_zero (n : ℕ) : Nat.nth (a · = 0) n = 0
proof:
:= by
  convert Nat.nth_false _ with i
  simp only [(hc.pos i).ne']

name: nth_apply_add_one_eq
statement: lemma nth_apply_add_one_eq {n : ℕ} (h : N ≤ n) : Nat.nth (a · = a n) (a (n + 1) - 1) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [hc.apply_add_one_eq_card h]
  nth_rw 5 [← Nat.nth_count (p := (a · = a n)) rfl]
  simp [Finset.range_add_one, Finset.filter_insert, Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]

name: apply_nth_add_one_eq
statement:
lemma apply_nth_add_one_eq {m n : ℕ} (hfc : ∀ hf : {i | a i = m}.Finite, n < #hf.toFinset)
    (hn : N ≤ Nat.nth (a · = m) n) : a (Nat.nth (a · = m) n + 1) = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [hc.apply_eq_card (Nat.lt_add_one_of_le hn), add_tsub_cancel_right,
    ← Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range, Nat.nth_mem n hfc, Nat.count_nth_succ hfc]

name: apply_nth_add_one_eq_of_infinite
statement:
lemma apply_nth_add_one_eq_of_infinite {m n : ℕ} (hi : {i | a i = m}.Infinite)
    (hn : N ≤ Nat.nth (a · = m) n) : a (Nat.nth (a · = m) n + 1) = n + 1
proof:
:=
  hc.apply_nth_add_one_eq (fun hf ↦ absurd hf hi) hn

name: apply_nth_add_one_eq_of_lt
statement:
lemma apply_nth_add_one_eq_of_lt {m n : ℕ} (hn : N < Nat.nth (a · = m) n) :
    a (Nat.nth (a · = m) n + 1) = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine hc.apply_nth_add_one_eq ?_ hn.le
  by_contra! hf
  have := Nat.nth_eq_zero.2 (.inr hf)
  lia

name: lt_toFinset_card
statement:
lemma lt_toFinset_card {j : ℕ} (h : M a N ≤ a (j + 1)) (hf : {i | a i = a j}.Finite) :
    M a N - 1 < #hf.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.sub_lt_iff_lt_add' (M_pos _ _), Nat.lt_one_add_iff]
  exact (hc.apply_eq_card (N_lt_of_M_le_apply h) ▸ h).trans (Finset.card_le_card (by simp))

name: nth_ne_zero_of_M_le_of_lt
statement:
lemma nth_ne_zero_of_M_le_of_lt {i k : ℕ} (hi : M a N ≤ a i) (hk : k < a (i + 1)) :
    Nat.nth (a · = a i) k ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  Nat.nth_ne_zero_anti (apply_ne_of_M_le_apply hi (Nat.zero_le _)) (by lia)
    (hc.nth_apply_add_one_eq (N_lt_of_M_le_apply hi).le ▸ ne_zero_of_M_le_apply hi)

name: apply_add_one_lt_of_apply_eq
statement:
lemma apply_add_one_lt_of_apply_eq {i j : ℕ} (hi : N ≤ i) (hij : i < j) (ha : a i = a j) :
    a (i + 1) < a (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hc.apply_add_one_eq_card hi, hc.apply_add_one_eq_card (by lia), ha]
  refine Finset.card_lt_card (Finset.ssubset_def.mp ⟨Finset.filter_subset_filter _
    (by simp [hij.le]), Finset.not_subset.mpr ⟨j, ?_⟩⟩)
  simpa using Order.add_one_le_iff.mpr hij

name: apply_add_one_ne_of_apply_eq
statement:
lemma apply_add_one_ne_of_apply_eq {i j : ℕ} (hi : N ≤ i) (hj : N ≤ j) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (ha : a i = a j) : a (i + 1) ≠ a (j + 1)
proof:
:=
  hij.lt_or_gt.elim (fun h ↦ (hc.apply_add_one_lt_of_apply_eq hi h ha).ne) fun h ↦
    (hc.apply_add_one_lt_of_apply_eq hj h ha.symm).ne'

name: exists_infinite_setOf_apply_eq
statement: lemma exists_infinite_setOf_apply_eq : ∃ m, {i | a i = m}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hi
  have hr : (Set.range a).Infinite := by
    contrapose! hi with hr
    rw [← Set.finite_coe_iff] at hr
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Finite.exists_infinite_fiber (Set.rangeFactorization a)
    rw [Set.infinite_coe_iff, Set.preimage] at hn
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.rangeFactorization, Subtype.ext_iff] at hn
    exact ⟨↑n, hn⟩
  simp only [not_exists, Set.not_infinite] at hi
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun i ↦ Nat.nth (a · = i) 0 + 1) (Set.range a \ Set.Ico 0 (M a N)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, hi⟩ _ ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, hj⟩ h
    simp only [Set.mem_Ico, zero_le, true_and, not_lt] at hi hj
    simp only [add_left_inj] at h
    convert congr(a $h) using 1 <;> simp [apply_nth_zero]
  refine Set.not_infinite.2 (hi 1) (Set.infinite_of_injOn_mapsTo hinj (fun i hi ↦ ?_)
    (hr.sdiff (Set.finite_Ico _ _)))
  simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_range, Set.mem_Ico, zero_le, true_and, not_lt] at hi
  rcases hi with ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, hi⟩
  exact hc.apply_nth_add_one_eq toFinset_card_pos
    (N_lt_of_M_le_apply (a := a) (by simp only [apply_nth_zero, hi])).le

name: nonempty_setOf_infinite_setOf_apply_eq
statement: lemma nonempty_setOf_infinite_setOf_apply_eq : {m | {i | a i = m}.Infinite}.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  hc.exists_infinite_setOf_apply_eq

name: injOn_setOf_apply_add_one_eq_of_M_le
statement:
lemma injOn_setOf_apply_add_one_eq_of_M_le {n : ℕ} (h : M a N ≤ n) :
    Set.InjOn a {i | a (i + 1) = n}
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi j hj hij
  have hi' := hi ▸ hc.nth_apply_add_one_eq (Nat.lt_add_one_iff.mp (N_lt_of_M_le_apply (hi ▸ h)))
  have hj' := hj ▸ hc.nth_apply_add_one_eq (Nat.lt_add_one_iff.mp (N_lt_of_M_le_apply (hj ▸ h)))
  rw [← hi', ← hj', hij]

name: empty_consecutive_apply_ge_M
statement: lemma empty_consecutive_apply_ge_M : {i | M a N ≤ a i ∧ M a N ≤ a (i + 1)} = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro i
  induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h i ih =>
  
  rintro ⟨hi1, hi2⟩
  have hi : ∀ j < i, M a N ≤ a j → a (j + 1) < M a N := by simp_all
  
  
  
  
  
  let t : Finset ℕ := {j ∈ Finset.range i | a (j + 1) = a i}
  let t' : Finset ℕ := {j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1) | a j = a i}
  have t_map_eq_t' : t.map ⟨(· + 1), add_left_injective 1⟩ = t' := by
    refine map_add_one_range (a · = a i) i ?_
    intro H
    rw [← H, M] at hi1
    have a0_le : a 0 ≤ (Finset.range (N + 1)).sup a := Finset.le_sup (by simp)
    lia
  have card_t_eq_card_t' : #t = #t' := by simp [← t_map_eq_t', t]
  have htM : ∀ j ∈ t, a j < M a N := by
    intro j hj
    simp only [t, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj
    obtain ⟨hj, hji⟩ := hj
    by_contra! hjM
    exact (lt_self_iff_false _).mp ((hji ▸ hi j hj hjM).trans_le hi1)
  have N_le_i : N ≤ i := by
    unfold M at hi1
    by_contra! HH
    have i_in_range : i ∈ Finset.range (N + 1) := by rw [Finset.mem_range]; lia
    have ai_le_sup : a i ≤ (Finset.range (N + 1)).sup a := Finset.le_sup i_in_range
    lia
  have ht' : a (i + 1) = #t' := hc.apply_add_one_eq_card N_le_i
  rw [← card_t_eq_card_t'] at ht'
  have ht'inj : Set.InjOn a t := by
    refine (hc.injOn_setOf_apply_add_one_eq_of_M_le hi1).mono ?_
    simp_all [t, t']
  have card_image_eq_card_t : #(Finset.image a t) = #t := Finset.card_image_of_injOn ht'inj
  have card_image_lt_M : #(Finset.image a t) < M a N := by
    refine (Finset.card_le_card (t := Finset.Ico 1 (M a N)) ?_).trans_lt ?_
    · simp only [Finset.subset_iff, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_Ico, forall_exists_index, and_imp,
                 forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
      exact fun j hj ↦ ⟨hc.pos _, htM j hj⟩
    · simpa using M_pos a N
  lia

name: card_lt_M_of_M_le
statement:
lemma card_lt_M_of_M_le {n : ℕ} (h : M a N ≤ n) :
    ∃ hf : {i | a i = n}.Finite, #hf.toFinset < M a N
proof:
:= by
  have := empty_consecutive_apply_ge_M hc
  contrapose! this with hin
  use Nat.nth (a · = n) (M a N - 1)
  have hin' := fun hf ↦ Nat.sub_one_lt_of_le (M_pos a N) (hin hf)
  have ha : M a N ≤ a (Nat.nth (a · = n) (M a N - 1)) := (Nat.nth_mem _ hin').symm ▸ h
  refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
  suffices H : a (Nat.nth (fun x ↦ a x = n) (M a N - 1) + 1) = M a N from Nat.le_of_eq H.symm
  convert! hc.apply_nth_add_one_eq hin' (N_lt_of_M_le_apply ha).le using 1

name: bddAbove_setOf_infinite_setOf_apply_eq
statement: lemma bddAbove_setOf_infinite_setOf_apply_eq : BddAbove {m | {i | a i = m}.Infinite}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨M a N, fun x hi ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hx
  exact hi (hc.card_lt_M_of_M_le (not_le.mp hx).le).1

name: infinite_setOf_apply_eq_anti
statement:
lemma infinite_setOf_apply_eq_anti {j k : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) (hk : {i | a i = k}.Infinite)
    (hjk : j ≤ k) : {i | a i = j}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : {i | a (i + 1) = k}.Infinite := by
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (· + 1) {i | a (i + 1) = k} := (add_left_injective _).injOn
    rw [← Set.infinite_image_iff hinj]
    have hk0 : ({i | a i = k} \ {0}).Infinite := hk.sdiff (Set.finite_singleton _)
    convert hk0 using 1
    ext i
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨j, rfl, rfl⟩
      simp
    · rintro ⟨rfl, h⟩
      exact ⟨i - 1, by simp [(by lia : i - 1 + 1 = i)]⟩
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x ↦ Nat.nth (a · = a x) (j - 1) + 1)
      ({i | a (i + 1) = k} \ Set.Ico 0 N) := by
    intro x hx y hy h
    simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_Ico, zero_le, true_and, not_lt] at hx hy
    rcases hx with ⟨hxk, hNx⟩
    rcases hy with ⟨hyk, hNy⟩
    simp only [add_left_inj] at h
    have hxk' : Nat.nth (a · = a x) (k - 1) = x := by rw [← hxk, hc.nth_apply_add_one_eq hNx]
    have hyk' : Nat.nth (a · = a y) (k - 1) = y := by rw [← hyk, hc.nth_apply_add_one_eq hNy]
    have hjk' : j - 1 ≤ k - 1 := by lia
    apply_fun a at hxk' hyk'
    have hyj : a (Nat.nth (a · = a y) (j - 1)) = a y :=
      Nat.nth_mem_anti (p := (a · = a y)) hjk' hyk'
    rw [← h, Nat.nth_mem_anti (p := (a · = a x)) hjk' hxk'] at hyj
    by_contra hxy
    exact hc.apply_add_one_ne_of_apply_eq hNx hNy hxy hyj (hyk ▸ hxk)
  have hk'' : (_ \ Set.Ico 0 (N + 2)).Infinite :=
    ((Set.infinite_image_iff hinj).mpr (hk'.sdiff (Set.finite_Ico _ _))).sdiff (Set.finite_Ico _ _)
  refine hk''.mono fun _ hi ↦ ?_
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_Ico, zero_le, true_and,
    not_lt] at hi
  rcases hi with ⟨⟨x, -, rfl⟩, _⟩
  rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hc.apply_nth_add_one_eq_of_lt (by lia), Nat.sub_add_cancel hj]

name: infinite_setOf_apply_eq_k
statement: lemma infinite_setOf_apply_eq_k : {i | a i = k a}.Infinite
proof:
:=
  Nat.sSup_mem hc.nonempty_setOf_infinite_setOf_apply_eq hc.bddAbove_setOf_infinite_setOf_apply_eq

name: infinite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_small
statement:
lemma infinite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_small {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    {i | a i = j}.Infinite ↔ Small a j
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ le_csSup hc.bddAbove_setOf_infinite_setOf_apply_eq h,
   fun h ↦ hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_anti hj hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_k h⟩

name: finite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_not_small
statement:
lemma finite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_not_small {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    {i | a i = j}.Finite ↔ ¬Small a j
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Set.not_infinite] using (hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_small hj).not

name: finite_setOf_apply_eq_k_add_one
statement: lemma finite_setOf_apply_eq_k_add_one : {i | a i = k a + 1}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [hc.finite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_not_small (by lia), Small]
  lia

name: finite_setOf_k_lt_card
statement: lemma finite_setOf_k_lt_card : {m | ∀ hf : {i | a i = m}.Finite, k a < #hf.toFinset}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.finite_image_iff]
  · refine Set.Finite.of_sdiff (hc.finite_setOf_apply_eq_k_add_one.subset fun i hi ↦ ?_)
      (Set.finite_Iic N)
    simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_Iic, not_le] at hi
    rcases hi with ⟨⟨j, hjf, rfl⟩, hNi⟩
    rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hc.apply_nth_add_one_eq hjf (by lia)]
  · intro i hi j hj hij
    simp only [add_left_inj] at hij
    apply_fun a at hij
    rwa [Nat.nth_mem _ hi, Nat.nth_mem _ hj] at hij

name: bddAbove_setOf_k_lt_card
statement: lemma bddAbove_setOf_k_lt_card : BddAbove {m | ∀ hf : {i | a i = m}.Finite, k a < #hf.toFinset}
proof:
:=
  hc.finite_setOf_k_lt_card.bddAbove

name: k_pos
statement: lemma k_pos : 0 < k a
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hn
  apply nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp hn ▸ hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_k
  convert Set.finite_empty
  ext i
  simp [(hc.pos i).ne']

name: small_one
statement: lemma small_one : Small a 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hns
  simp only [Small, not_le, Nat.lt_one_iff, hc.k_pos.ne'] at hns

name: infinite_setOf_apply_eq_one
statement: lemma infinite_setOf_apply_eq_one : {i | a i = 1}.Infinite
proof:
:=
  (hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_small (by decide)).mpr hc.small_one

name: k_le_l
statement: lemma k_le_l : k a ≤ l a
proof:
:=
  le_csSup hc.bddAbove_setOf_k_lt_card (fun hf ↦ absurd hf hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_k)

name: k_lt_of_big
statement: lemma k_lt_of_big {j : ℕ} (h : Big a j) : k a < j
proof:
:=
  hc.k_le_l.trans_lt h

name: pos_of_big
statement: lemma pos_of_big {j : ℕ} (h : Big a j) : 0 < j
proof:
:=
  (Nat.zero_le _).trans_lt (hc.k_lt_of_big h)

name: not_small_of_big
statement: lemma not_small_of_big {j : ℕ} (h : Big a j) : ¬Small a j
proof: := by simp [Small, hc.k_lt_of_big h]

name: exists_card_le_of_big
statement:
lemma exists_card_le_of_big {j : ℕ} (h : Big a j) :
    ∃ hf : {i | a i = j}.Finite, #hf.toFinset ≤ k a
proof:
:= by
  have hns := hc.not_small_of_big h
  rw [← hc.finite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_not_small (hc.pos_of_big h)] at hns
  use hns
  by_contra! hlt
  exact notMem_of_csSup_lt h hc.bddAbove_setOf_k_lt_card fun _ ↦ hlt

name: not_medium_of_N'aux_lt
statement: lemma not_medium_of_N'aux_lt {j : ℕ} (h : N'aux a N < j) : ¬Medium a (a j)
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set ℕ := ⋃ i ∈ Set.Ioc (k a) (l a), {j | a j = i}
  have hf : s.Finite := by
    refine (Set.finite_Ioc _ _).biUnion ?_
    rintro i ⟨hk, -⟩
    rwa [hc.finite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_not_small (by lia), Small, not_le]
  exact fun hm ↦ notMem_of_csSup_lt (le_sup_left.trans_lt h)
    (hf.subset fun i hi ↦ (by simpa [s, Medium] using hi)).bddAbove hm

name: small_or_big_of_N'aux_lt
statement: lemma small_or_big_of_N'aux_lt {j : ℕ} (h : N'aux a N < j) : Small a (a j) ∨ Big a (a j)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := hc.not_medium_of_N'aux_lt h
  rw [Small, Medium, Big] at *
  lia

name: small_or_big_of_N'_le
statement: lemma small_or_big_of_N'_le {j : ℕ} (h : N' a N ≤ j) : Small a (a j) ∨ Big a (a j)
proof:
:= by
  refine hc.small_or_big_of_N'aux_lt ?_
  rw [N'] at h
  lia

name: nth_sup_k_N_add_one_le_N'aux_of_small
statement:
lemma nth_sup_k_N_add_one_le_N'aux_of_small {j : ℕ} (h : Small a j) :
    Nat.nth (a · = j) (k a ⊔ (N + 1)) ≤ N'aux a N
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hn
  exact notMem_of_csSup_lt (le_sup_right.trans_lt hn) ((Set.finite_Iic _).image _).bddAbove
    ⟨j, h, rfl⟩

name: nth_sup_k_le_N'aux_of_small
statement:
lemma nth_sup_k_le_N'aux_of_small {j : ℕ} (h : Small a j) :
    Nat.nth (a · = j) (k a) ≤ N'aux a N
proof:
:=
  match j with
  | 0 => by simp only [hc.nth_apply_eq_zero, zero_le]
  | j + 1 => ((Nat.nth_le_nth ((hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_small (Nat.zero_lt_succ j)).mpr h)).2
      le_sup_left).trans (nth_sup_k_N_add_one_le_N'aux_of_small h)

name: nth_sup_N_add_one_le_N'aux_of_small
statement:
lemma nth_sup_N_add_one_le_N'aux_of_small {j : ℕ} (h : Small a j) :
    Nat.nth (a · = j) (N + 1) ≤ N'aux a N
proof:
:=
  match j with
  | 0 => by simp only [hc.nth_apply_eq_zero, zero_le]
  | j + 1 => ((Nat.nth_le_nth ((hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_small (Nat.zero_lt_succ j)).mpr h)).2
      le_sup_right).trans (nth_sup_k_N_add_one_le_N'aux_of_small h)

name: N_lt_N'aux
statement: lemma N_lt_N'aux : N < N'aux a N
proof:
:=
  Nat.add_one_le_iff.mp ((Nat.le_nth fun hf ↦ absurd hf hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_one).trans
    (hc.nth_sup_N_add_one_le_N'aux_of_small hc.small_one))

name: N_lt_N'
statement: lemma N_lt_N' : N < N' a N
proof: := hc.N_lt_N'aux.trans_le (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

name: lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_nth_lt
statement:
lemma lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_nth_lt {i j t : ℕ} (hj0 : 0 < j) (h : Small a j)
    (ht : Nat.nth (a · = j) t < i) : t < #{m ∈ Finset.range i | a m = j}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_small hj0] at h
  rw [← Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
  exact (Nat.nth_lt_nth h).mp (ht.trans_le (Nat.le_nth_count h _))

name: k_lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_of_N'aux_le
statement:
lemma k_lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_of_N'aux_le {i j : ℕ} (hj0 : 0 < j) (h : Small a j)
    (hN'aux : N'aux a N < i) : k a < #{m ∈ Finset.range i | a m = j}
proof:
:=
  hc.lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_nth_lt hj0 h ((hc.nth_sup_k_le_N'aux_of_small h).trans_lt hN'aux)

name: N_add_one_lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_of_N'aux_le
statement:
lemma N_add_one_lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_of_N'aux_le {i j : ℕ} (hj0 : 0 < j) (h : Small a j)
    (hN'aux : N'aux a N < i) : N + 1 < #{m ∈ Finset.range i | a m = j}
proof:
:=
  hc.lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_nth_lt hj0 h
    ((hc.nth_sup_N_add_one_le_N'aux_of_small h).trans_lt hN'aux)

name: N_add_one_lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_of_N'_le
statement:
lemma N_add_one_lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_of_N'_le {i j : ℕ} (hj0 : 0 < j) (h : Small a j)
    (hN' : N' a N < i) : N + 1 < #{m ∈ Finset.range i | a m = j}
proof:
:= by
  refine hc.N_add_one_lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_of_N'aux_le hj0 h ?_
  rw [N'] at hN'
  exact Nat.lt_of_add_right_lt hN'

name: apply_add_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'aux_le
statement:
lemma apply_add_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'aux_le {i : ℕ} (h : Small a (a i))
    (hN'aux : N'aux a N ≤ i) : Big a (a (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hN'' : N'aux a N < i + 1 := by lia
  suffices ¬Small a (a (i + 1)) by simpa [this] using hc.small_or_big_of_N'aux_lt hN''
  rw [hc.apply_add_one_eq_card (hc.N_lt_N'aux.le.trans hN'aux), Small, not_le]
  exact hc.k_lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_of_N'aux_le (hc.pos _) h hN''

name: apply_add_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_le
statement:
lemma apply_add_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_le {i : ℕ} (h : Small a (a i)) (hN' : N' a N ≤ i) :
    Big a (a (i + 1))
proof:
:=
  hc.apply_add_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'aux_le h ((Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans hN')

name: apply_add_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'aux_le
statement:
lemma apply_add_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'aux_le {i : ℕ} (h : Big a (a i))
    (hN'aux : N'aux a N ≤ i) : Small a (a (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hf, hfc⟩ := hc.exists_card_le_of_big h
  rw [hc.apply_add_one_eq_card (hc.N_lt_N'aux.le.trans hN'aux)]
  exact (Finset.card_le_card (by simp)).trans hfc

name: apply_add_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'_le
statement:
lemma apply_add_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'_le {i : ℕ} (h : Big a (a i)) (hN' : N' a N ≤ i) :
    Small a (a (i + 1))
proof:
:=
  hc.apply_add_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'aux_le h ((Nat.le_add_right _ _).trans hN')

name: apply_add_two_small_of_apply_small_of_N'_le
statement:
lemma apply_add_two_small_of_apply_small_of_N'_le {i : ℕ} (h : Small a (a i)) (hN' : N' a N ≤ i) :
    Small a (a (i + 2))
proof:
:=
  hc.apply_add_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'_le (hc.apply_add_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_le h hN')
    (by lia)

name: small_apply_N'
statement: lemma small_apply_N' : Small a (a (N' a N))
proof:
:= by
  rw [N']
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact hi
  · have hb : Big a (a (N'aux a N + 1)) := by
      simpa [hi] using hc.small_or_big_of_N'aux_lt (Nat.lt_add_one (N'aux a N))
    exact hc.apply_add_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'aux_le hb (by lia)

name: small_apply_N'_add_iff_even
statement: lemma small_apply_N'_add_iff_even {n : ℕ} : Small a (a (N' a N + n)) ↔ Even n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hc.small_apply_N'
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases he : Even n <;> rw [← add_assoc] <;> simp only [he, iff_true, iff_false] at ih
    · have hne : ¬ Even (n + 1) := by simp [Nat.not_even_iff_odd, he]
      simp only [hne, iff_false]
      exact hc.not_small_of_big (hc.apply_add_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_le ih (by grind))
    · have hb : Big a (a (N' a N + n)) := by
        simpa [ih] using hc.small_or_big_of_N'_le (j := N' a N + n) (by lia)
      simp [hc.apply_add_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'_le hb (by lia), Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp he]

name: small_apply_add_two_mul_iff_small
statement:
lemma small_apply_add_two_mul_iff_small {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (hN' : N' a N ≤ n) :
    Small a (a (n + 2 * m)) ↔ Small a (a n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show n = N' a N + (n - N' a N) by lia, add_assoc, hc.small_apply_N'_add_iff_even,
    hc.small_apply_N'_add_iff_even]
  simp [Nat.even_add]

name: apply_sub_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'_le
statement:
lemma apply_sub_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'_le {i : ℕ} (h : Big a (a i)) (hN' : N' a N ≤ i) :
    Small a (a (i - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h0i : 1 ≤ i := by
    have := hc.N_lt_N'
    lia
  have h' : N' a N ≤ i - 1 := by
    by_contra hi
    have hi' : i = N' a N := by lia
    exact hc.not_small_of_big (hi' ▸ h) hc.small_apply_N'
  exact (hc.small_or_big_of_N'_le h').elim id fun hb ↦
    False.elim (hc.not_small_of_big h (Nat.sub_add_cancel h0i ▸
      (hc.apply_add_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'_le hb h')))

name: apply_sub_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt
statement:
lemma apply_sub_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt {i : ℕ} (h : Small a (a i)) (hN' : N' a N < i) :
    Big a (a (i - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h0i : 1 ≤ i := by lia
  have h' : N' a N ≤ i - 1 := by lia
  exact (hc.small_or_big_of_N'_le h').elim (fun hs ↦ False.elim (hc.not_small_of_big
    (Nat.sub_add_cancel h0i ▸ hc.apply_add_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_le hs h') h)) id

name: apply_sub_two_small_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt
statement:
lemma apply_sub_two_small_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt {i : ℕ} (h : Small a (a i)) (hN' : N' a N < i) :
    Small a (a (i - 2))
proof:
:= by
  convert! hc.apply_sub_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'_le
    (hc.apply_sub_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt h hN') (by lia) using 1

name: N_add_one_lt_apply_of_apply_big_of_N'_le
statement:
lemma N_add_one_lt_apply_of_apply_big_of_N'_le {i : ℕ} (h : Big a (a i)) (hN' : N' a N ≤ i) :
    N + 1 < a i
proof:
:= by
  refine hc.apply_eq_card (hc.N_lt_N'.trans_le hN') ▸
    hc.N_add_one_lt_card_filter_eq_of_small_of_N'_le (hc.pos _)
      (hc.apply_sub_one_small_of_apply_big_of_N'_le h hN') ?_
  by_contra
  exact hc.not_small_of_big ((by lia : i = N' a N) ▸ h) hc.small_apply_N'

name: setOf_apply_eq_of_apply_big_of_N'_le
proof:
:= by
  have hs : {j | N < j ∧ Small a (a (j - 1)) ∧ a i = #{t ∈ Finset.range j | a t = a (j - 1)}} ⊆
      {j | a j = a i} := by
    rintro _ ⟨hNj, -, hj⟩
    exact hj ▸ hc.apply_eq_card hNj
  rcases hc.exists_card_le_of_big h with ⟨hf, hck⟩
  have hf' : {j | N < j ∧ Small a (a (j - 1)) ∧
    a i = #{t ∈ Finset.range j | a t = a (j - 1)}}.Finite := hf.subset hs
  suffices hf.toFinset = hf'.toFinset by simpa using this
  rw [← Set.Finite.toFinset_subset_toFinset (hs := hf') (ht := hf)] at hs
  refine (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hs (hck.trans ?_)).symm
  have hs : #((Finset.Icc 1 (k a)).image (fun t ↦ Nat.nth (a · = t) (a i - 1) + 1)) = k a := by
    convert Finset.card_image_of_injOn fun t ht u hu htu ↦ ?_
    · simp only [Nat.card_Icc, add_tsub_cancel_right]
    · simp only [add_left_inj] at htu
      simp only [Finset.coe_Icc, Set.mem_Icc] at ht hu
      rw [← Small, ← hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_small (by lia)] at ht hu
      apply_fun a at htu
      rwa [Nat.nth_mem_of_infinite ht.2, Nat.nth_mem_of_infinite hu.2] at htu
  refine hs ▸ Finset.card_le_card (Finset.subset_iff.2 fun j hj ↦ ?_)
  simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_Icc] at hj
  rcases hj with ⟨t, ⟨ht1, htk⟩, rfl⟩
  have hN1 : N < a i - 1 := by
    have := hc.N_add_one_lt_apply_of_apply_big_of_N'_le h hN'
    lia
  simp only [add_tsub_cancel_right]
  rw [← Small] at htk
  have htki := htk
  rw [← hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_small (by lia)] at htki
  rw [Nat.nth_mem_of_infinite htki]
  simp only [htk, true_and]
  refine ⟨Nat.lt_add_one_iff.mpr ((Nat.le_nth (fun hf ↦ absurd hf htki)).trans
    ((Nat.nth_le_nth htki).2 hN1.le)), ?_⟩
  rw [← Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range, Nat.count_nth_succ_of_infinite htki]
  lia

name: N_lt_of_apply_eq_of_apply_big_of_N'_le
statement:
lemma N_lt_of_apply_eq_of_apply_big_of_N'_le {i j : ℕ} (hj : a j = a i) (h : Big a (a i))
    (hN' : N' a N ≤ i) : N < j
proof:
:=
  have hj' : j ∈ {t | a t = a i} := by simpa using hj
  (hc.setOf_apply_eq_of_apply_big_of_N'_le h hN' ▸ hj').1

name: small_apply_sub_one_of_apply_eq_of_apply_big_of_N'_le
statement:
lemma small_apply_sub_one_of_apply_eq_of_apply_big_of_N'_le {i j : ℕ} (hj : a j = a i)
    (h : Big a (a i)) (hN' : N' a N ≤ i) : Small a (a (j - 1))
proof:
:=
  have hj' : j ∈ {t | a t = a i} := by simpa using hj
  (hc.setOf_apply_eq_of_apply_big_of_N'_le h hN' ▸ hj').2.1

name: apply_add_one_eq_card_small_le_card_eq
statement:
lemma apply_add_one_eq_card_small_le_card_eq {i : ℕ} (hi : N' a N < i) (hib : Big a (a i)) :
    a (i + 1) = #{m ∈ Finset.range (k a + 1) | a i ≤ #{j ∈ Finset.range i | a j = m}}
proof:
:= by
  rw [hc.apply_add_one_eq_card (hc.N_lt_N'.trans hi).le]
  convert Finset.card_image_of_injOn (f := fun j ↦ Nat.nth (a · = j) (a i - 1) + 1) ?_ using 1
  · congr
    ext j
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_image]
    refine ⟨fun ⟨hj, hji⟩ ↦ ⟨a (j - 1), hji ▸ ?_⟩, fun ⟨t, ⟨hts, htr⟩, ht⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
    · have hjN : N < j := hc.N_lt_of_apply_eq_of_apply_big_of_N'_le hji hib hi.le
      refine ⟨⟨Nat.lt_add_one_iff.mpr (hc.small_apply_sub_one_of_apply_eq_of_apply_big_of_N'_le
        hji hib hi.le), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [hc.apply_eq_card hjN]
        have : j ≤ i := by lia
        gcongr
      · have hj1 : j = j - 1 + 1 := by lia
        nth_rw 2 [hj1]
        rw [hc.nth_apply_add_one_eq (by lia), hj1.symm]
    · subst ht
      rw [Nat.lt_add_one_iff, ← Small] at hts
      have ht0 : 0 < t := by
        by_contra! h0
        simp [nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp h0, hc.apply_ne_zero] at htr
      rw [← hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_small ht0] at hts
      rw [← Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range] at htr
      constructor
      · rwa [add_lt_add_iff_right, ← Nat.lt_nth_iff_count_lt hts,
          Nat.sub_lt_iff_lt_add' (hc.one_le_apply _), Nat.lt_one_add_iff]
      · rw [hc.apply_nth_add_one_eq_of_infinite hts]
        · exact Nat.sub_add_cancel (hc.one_le_apply _)
        · refine (Nat.le_nth fun hf ↦ absurd hf hts).trans ((Nat.nth_le_nth hts).2 ?_)
          have := hc.N_add_one_lt_apply_of_apply_big_of_N'_le hib hi.le
          lia
  · intro t ht u hu htu
    simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_range, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Nat.lt_add_one_iff] at ht hu
    rw [← Small] at ht hu
    have ht0 : 0 < t := by
      by_contra! h0
      simp only [nonpos_iff_eq_zero] at h0
      simp [h0, hc.apply_ne_zero] at ht
    have hu0 : 0 < u := by
      by_contra! h0
      simp only [nonpos_iff_eq_zero] at h0
      simp [h0, hc.apply_ne_zero] at hu
    rw [← hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_small ht0] at ht
    rw [← hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_iff_small hu0] at hu
    simp only [add_left_inj] at htu
    apply_fun a at htu
    rwa [Nat.nth_mem_of_infinite ht.1, Nat.nth_mem_of_infinite hu.1] at htu

name: apply_eq_card_small_le_card_eq_of_small
proof:
:= by
  have hib : Big a (a (i - 1)) := hc.apply_sub_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt his (by lia)
  nth_rw 1 [show i = i - 1 + 1 by lia]
  rw [hc.apply_add_one_eq_card_small_le_card_eq (by lia) hib]
  congr 1
  ext j
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, and_congr_right_iff]
  intro hj
  convert Iff.rfl using 2
  congr 1
  ext t
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨hti, rfl⟩ ↦ ⟨?_, rfl⟩, fun ⟨_, rfl⟩ ↦ ⟨by lia, rfl⟩⟩
  by_contra hti1
  have htieq : t = i - 1 := by lia
  subst htieq
  exact hc.not_small_of_big hib (Nat.lt_add_one_iff.mp hj)

name: exists_apply_sub_two_eq_of_apply_eq
statement:
lemma exists_apply_sub_two_eq_of_apply_eq {i j : ℕ} (hi : N' a N + 2 < i) (hijlt : i < j)
    (his : Small a (a i)) (hijeq : a i = a j)
    (hij1 : ∀ t, Small a t → #{x ∈ Finset.Ico i j | a x = t} ≤ 1) :
    ∃ t, t ∈ Finset.Ico i j ∧ a (i - 2) = a t
proof:
:= by
  let I : Finset ℕ := {t ∈ Finset.range (k a + 1) | a (i - 1) ≤ #{u ∈ Finset.range i | a u = t}}
  let J : Finset ℕ := {t ∈ Finset.range (k a + 1) | a (j - 1) ≤ #{u ∈ Finset.range j | a u = t}}
  have hIc : a i = #I := hc.apply_eq_card_small_le_card_eq_of_small (by lia) his
  have hJc : a j = #J := hc.apply_eq_card_small_le_card_eq_of_small (by lia) (hijeq ▸ his)
  have hIJc : #I = #J := hIc ▸ hJc ▸ hijeq
  have := hc.N_lt_N'
  have hiju : Finset.range i ∪ Finset.Ico i j = Finset.range j := by
    rw [Finset.range_eq_Ico, Finset.Ico_union_Ico' (by lia) (by lia)]
    simp [hijlt.le]
  have hi2s : a (i - 2) < k a + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_add_one_iff.mpr (hc.apply_sub_two_small_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt his (by lia))
  have hiI : a (i - 2) ∈ I := by
    simp only [I, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, hi2s, true_and]
    rw [hc.apply_eq_card (by lia), show i - 1 - 1 = i - 2 by lia]
    exact Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter _  (by simp))
  have hj2s : a (j - 2) < k a + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_add_one_iff.mpr (hc.apply_sub_two_small_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt (hijeq ▸ his) (by lia))
  have hjJ : a (j - 2) ∈ J := by
    simp only [J, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, hj2s, true_and]
    rw [hc.apply_eq_card (by lia), show j - 1 - 1 = j - 2 by lia]
    exact Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter _  (by simp))
  have hjI : a (j - 2) ∈ I := by
    by_contra hjI
    have hjIf := hjI
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, hj2s, true_and, not_le, I,
      Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le] at hjIf
    have hjI' : a (j - 1) ≤ a (i - 1) := by
      calc a (j - 1) ≤ #{u ∈ Finset.range j | a u = a (j - 2)} :=
            (Finset.mem_filter.mp hjJ).2
        _ = #{u ∈ Finset.range i ∪ Finset.Ico i j | a u = a (j - 2)} := by rw [hiju]
        _ ≤ #{u ∈ Finset.range i | a u = a (j - 2)} + #{u ∈ Finset.Ico i j | a u = a (j - 2)} := by
            rw [Finset.filter_union]
            exact Finset.card_union_le _ _
        _ ≤ #{u ∈ Finset.range i | a u = a (j - 2)} + 1 := by
            gcongr
            exact hij1 _ (by rwa [Nat.lt_add_one_iff, ← Small] at hj2s)
        _ ≤ a (i - 1) := hjIf
    refine hjI (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (fun x hxI ↦ ?_) hIJc.symm.le ▸ hjJ)
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, I, J] at *
    refine ⟨hxI.1, ?_⟩
    calc a (j - 1) ≤ a (i - 1) := hjI'
      _ ≤ #{u ∈ Finset.range i | a u = x} := hxI.2
      _ ≤ #{u ∈ Finset.range j | a u = x} :=
        Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter _ (by simp [hijlt.le]))
  have hi1j1 : a (i - 1) + 1 ≤ a (j - 1) := by
    calc a (i - 1) + 1 ≤ #{u ∈ Finset.range i | a u = a (j - 2)} + 1 := by
          gcongr
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, I] at hjI
          exact hjI.2
      _ ≤ #{u ∈ Finset.range i | a u = a (j - 2)} + #{u ∈ Finset.Ico i j | a u = a (j - 2)} := by
          gcongr
          simp only [Finset.one_le_card]
          refine ⟨j - 2, ?_⟩
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ico, and_true]
          refine ⟨?_, by lia⟩
          by_contra hj
          have hj' : j = i + 1 := by lia
          subst hj'
          exact hc.not_small_of_big (hc.apply_add_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_le his (by lia))
            (hijeq ▸ his)
      _ = #({u ∈ Finset.range i | a u = a (j - 2)} ∪ {u ∈ Finset.Ico i j | a u = a (j - 2)}) := by
          refine (Finset.card_union_of_disjoint ?_).symm
          simp only [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Ico,
            and_imp]
          rintro t hti - u hiu - -
          lia
      _ = #{u ∈ Finset.range j | a u = a (j - 2)} := by
          rw [← Finset.filter_union, hiju]
      _ = a (j - 1) := by
          rw [hc.apply_eq_card (show N < j - 1 by lia)]
          congr 1
          ext t
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
          refine ⟨fun ⟨htj, htj'⟩ ↦ ⟨?_, by convert! htj' using 1⟩,
            fun ⟨htj, htj'⟩ ↦ ⟨by lia, by convert! htj' using 1⟩⟩
          by_contra htj''
          have ht1 : t = j - 1 := by lia
          subst ht1
          exact hc.not_small_of_big (htj' ▸ hc.apply_sub_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt
            (hijeq ▸ his) (by lia)) (hc.apply_sub_two_small_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt
            (hijeq ▸ his) (by lia))
  have hIJ : I = J := by
    refine (Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (Finset.subset_iff.mp fun x hxJ ↦ ?_) hIJc.le).symm
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, I, J, Nat.lt_add_one_iff] at *
    refine ⟨hxJ.1, (add_le_add_iff_right 1).mp ?_⟩
    calc a (i - 1) + 1 ≤ a (j - 1) := hi1j1
       _ ≤ #{u ∈ Finset.range j | a u = x} := hxJ.2
       _ = #({u ∈ Finset.range i | a u = x} ∪ {u ∈ Finset.Ico i j | a u = x}) := by
           rw [← Finset.filter_union, hiju]
       _ ≤ #{u ∈ Finset.range i | a u = x} + #{u ∈ Finset.Ico i j | a u = x} :=
           Finset.card_union_le _ _
       _ ≤ #{u ∈ Finset.range i | a u = x} + 1 := by
           gcongr
           exact hij1 _ hxJ.1
  simp only [hIJ, J, Finset.mem_filter] at hiI
  have hiI' := hi1j1.trans hiI.2
  rw [hc.apply_eq_card (by lia), show i - 1 - 1 = i - 2 by lia, Nat.add_one_le_iff,
     ← not_le] at hiI'
  rcases Finset.not_subset.mp (mt Finset.card_le_card hiI') with ⟨t, htj, hti⟩
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at htj hti
  simp only [htj.2, and_true, not_lt, tsub_le_iff_right] at hti
  refine ⟨t, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨?_, htj.1⟩, htj.2.symm⟩
  by_contra
  have hti' : t = i - 1 := by lia
  subst hti'
  exact hc.not_small_of_big (hc.apply_sub_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt his (by lia)) (htj.2 ▸
    (hc.apply_sub_two_small_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt his (by lia)))

name: nonempty_pSet
statement: lemma nonempty_pSet (n : ℕ) : (pSet a n).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rcases hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_one.exists_gt n with ⟨i, hi1, hni⟩
  rcases hc.infinite_setOf_apply_eq_one.exists_gt i with ⟨j, hj1, hij⟩
  refine ⟨j - n, ?_⟩
  simp only [pSet, Finset.mem_Ico, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  exact ⟨i, ⟨hni.le, by lia⟩, hi1 ▸ ⟨hc.small_one, hj1 ▸ (by congr; lia)⟩⟩

name: exists_mem_Ico_small_and_apply_add_p_eq
statement:
lemma exists_mem_Ico_small_and_apply_add_p_eq (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ i ∈ Finset.Ico n (n + p a n), Small a (a i) ∧ a (n + p a n) = a i
proof:
:=
  csInf_mem (hc.nonempty_pSet _)

name: p_pos
statement: lemma p_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < p a n
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have hn := hc.exists_mem_Ico_small_and_apply_add_p_eq n
  simp [h] at hn

name: card_filter_apply_eq_Ico_add_p_le_one
statement:
lemma card_filter_apply_eq_Ico_add_p_le_one (n : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hjs : Small a j) :
    #{i ∈ Finset.Ico n (n + p a n) | a i = j} ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsLeast (pSet a n) (p a n) := isLeast_csInf (hc.nonempty_pSet n)
  simp only [IsLeast, pSet, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, mem_lowerBounds, forall_exists_index, and_imp,
    Finset.mem_Ico] at h
  rw [Finset.card_le_one_iff]
  intro x y hx hy
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ico] at hx hy
  rcases lt_trichotomy x y with hxy | rfl | hxy
  · replace h := h.2 (y - n) x hx.1.1 (by lia) (hx.2 ▸ hjs)
    have hny : n + (y - n) = y := by lia
    rw [hny, hy.2, hx.2] at h
    exact absurd (h rfl) (by lia)
  · rfl
  · replace h := h.2 (x - n) y hy.1.1 (by lia) (hy.2 ▸ hjs)
    have hnx : n + (x - n) = x := by lia
    rw [hnx, hx.2, hy.2] at h
    exact absurd (h rfl) (by lia)

name: apply_add_p_eq
statement: lemma apply_add_p_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : N' a N + 2 < n) (hs : Small a (a n)) : a (n + p a n) = a n
proof:
:= by
  rcases hc.exists_mem_Ico_small_and_apply_add_p_eq n with ⟨i, hiIco, his, hin⟩
  suffices i = n by rw [hin, this]
  simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hiIco
  by_contra hin'
  have hf (t : ℕ) (hts : Small a t) : #{x ∈ Finset.Ico i (n + p a n) | a x = t} ≤ 1 :=
    calc #{x ∈ Finset.Ico i (n + p a n) | a x = t} ≤ #{x ∈ Finset.Ico n (n + p a n) | a x = t} :=
        Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter _ (Finset.Ico_subset_Ico hiIco.1 le_rfl))
      _ ≤ 1 := hc.card_filter_apply_eq_Ico_add_p_le_one _ hts
  obtain ⟨t, hti, hi2t⟩ := hc.exists_apply_sub_two_eq_of_apply_eq (j := n + p a n) (by lia)
    (by lia) his hin.symm hf
  have h1 := hc.card_filter_apply_eq_Ico_add_p_le_one n
    (hi2t ▸ hc.apply_sub_two_small_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt his (by lia))
  revert h1
  simp only [imp_false, not_le, Finset.one_lt_card_iff, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ico, ne_eq,
    exists_and_left]
  simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hti
  refine ⟨i - 2, ⟨⟨?_, by lia⟩, hi2t⟩, t, by lia⟩
  by_contra hi2
  have hi1 : n = i - 1 := by lia
  subst hi1
  exact hc.not_small_of_big (hc.apply_sub_one_big_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt his (by lia)) hs

name: even_p
statement: lemma even_p {n : ℕ} (hn : N' a N + 2 < n) (hs : Small a (a n)) : Even (p a n)
proof:
:= by
  have hna : n = N' a N + (n - (N' a N)) := by lia
  have hs' := hc.apply_add_p_eq hn hs ▸ hs
  rw [hna, hc.small_apply_N'_add_iff_even] at hs
  nth_rw 1 [hna] at hs'
  rw [add_assoc, hc.small_apply_N'_add_iff_even] at hs'
  simpa [Nat.even_add, hs] using hs'

name: p_le_two_mul_k
statement: lemma p_le_two_mul_k {n : ℕ} (hn : N' a N + 2 < n) (hs : Small a (a n)) : p a n ≤ 2 * k a
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxyne, hxy⟩ : ∃ x ∈ Finset.range (k a + 1), ∃ y ∈ Finset.range (k a + 1),
      x ≠ y ∧ a (n + 2 * x) = a (n + 2 * y) := by
    convert Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to (t := Finset.Icc 1 (k a)) ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · rintro i -
      simp only [Finset.coe_Icc, Set.mem_Icc]
      rw [← Small, hc.small_apply_add_two_mul_iff_small i (by lia)]
      simp [hs, hc.one_le_apply]
  have hs' : Small a (a (n + 2 * x)) := by rwa [hc.small_apply_add_two_mul_iff_small x (by lia)]
  have hj := hc.card_filter_apply_eq_Ico_add_p_le_one n hs'
  revert hj
  simp only [imp_false, not_le, Finset.one_lt_card_iff, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ico, ne_eq,
    exists_and_left]
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hx hy
  exact ⟨n + 2 * x, by lia, n + 2 * y, by lia⟩

name: p_apply_sub_two_le_p_apply
statement:
lemma p_apply_sub_two_le_p_apply {n : ℕ} (hn : N' a N + 4 < n) (hs : Small a (a n)) :
    p a (n - 2) ≤ p a n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hti, _⟩ := hc.exists_apply_sub_two_eq_of_apply_eq (j := n + p a n) (by lia)
    ((lt_add_iff_pos_right n).mpr (hc.p_pos n)) hs
    (hc.apply_add_p_eq (by lia) hs).symm (fun _ ↦ hc.card_filter_apply_eq_Ico_add_p_le_one _)
  by_contra
  have hn2 := (hc.apply_sub_two_small_of_apply_small_of_N'_lt hs (by lia))
  have : p a n ≤ p a (n - 2) - 2 := by
    obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := hc.even_p (by lia) hs
    obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := hc.even_p (by lia) hn2
    lia
  have h := hc.card_filter_apply_eq_Ico_add_p_le_one (n - 2) hn2
  revert h
  simp only [imp_false, not_le, Finset.one_lt_card_iff, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ico,
    ne_eq, exists_and_left]
  simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hti
  exact ⟨n - 2, ⟨⟨le_rfl, by lia⟩, rfl⟩, t, by lia⟩

name: p_apply_le_p_apply_add_two
statement:
lemma p_apply_le_p_apply_add_two {n : ℕ} (hn : N' a N + 2 < n) (hs : Small a (a n)) :
    p a n ≤ p a (n + 2)
proof:
:=
  hc.p_apply_sub_two_le_p_apply (n := n + 2) (by lia)
    (hc.apply_add_two_small_of_apply_small_of_N'_le hs (by lia))

name: exists_p_eq
statement: lemma exists_p_eq : ∃ b c, ∀ n, b < n → p a (N' a N + 2 * n) = c
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℕ := sSup (Set.range (fun i ↦ p a (N' a N + 2 * (2 + i))))
  have hk : 2 * k a ∈ upperBounds (Set.range (fun i ↦ p a (N' a N + 2 * (2 + i)))) := by
    simp only [mem_upperBounds, Set.mem_range, forall_exists_index, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff]
    exact fun i ↦ hc.p_le_two_mul_k (by lia) (hc.small_apply_N'_add_iff_even.mpr (by simp))
  have hlec : ∀ j ∈ Set.range (fun i ↦ p a (N' a N + 2 * (2 + i))), j ≤ c :=
    fun _ hj ↦ le_csSup ⟨_, hk⟩ hj
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Set.Nonempty.csSup_mem (Set.range_nonempty _) (BddAbove.finite ⟨2 * k a, hk⟩)
  have heqc (u : ℕ) : p a (N' a N + 2 * (2 + t + u)) = c := by
    induction u with
    | zero => simpa using ht
    | succ u ih =>
      refine le_antisymm ?_ (ih ▸ ?_)
      · simp only [Set.mem_range, forall_exists_index, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff] at hlec
        exact add_assoc _ _ (u + 1) ▸ hlec (t + (u + 1))
      · have hs : Small a (a (N' a N + 2 * (2 + t + u))) := by
          rw [hc.small_apply_N'_add_iff_even]
          simp
        convert! hc.p_apply_le_p_apply_add_two (by lia) hs using 1
  refine ⟨1 + t, c, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [show n = 2 + t + (n - (2 + t)) by lia]
  exact heqc _

name: exists_a_apply_add_eq
statement:
lemma exists_a_apply_add_eq : ∃ b c, 0 < c ∧ ∀ n, b < n →
    a (N' a N + 2 * n + 2 * c) = a (N' a N + 2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, c', hbc'⟩ := hc.exists_p_eq a N
  have hs (n : ℕ) : Small a (a (N' a N + 2 * n)) := hc.small_apply_N'_add_iff_even.mpr (by simp)
  refine ⟨b + 2, c' / 2, ?_, fun n hbn ↦ hbc' n (by lia) ▸ ?_⟩
  · have := hbc' (b + 2) (by lia)
    have := hc.p_pos (N' a N + 2 * (b + 2))
    rcases hc.even_p (by lia) (hs (b + 2)) with ⟨_, _⟩
    lia
  · convert hc.apply_add_p_eq (by lia) (hs n) using 3
    rcases hc.even_p (by lia) (hs n) with ⟨_, ht⟩
    simp [ht, ← two_mul]

name: sum_successive_terms_intCast
statement:
theorem sum_successive_terms_intCast {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n → ℤ) (start : Fin n) (count : ℕ) [NeZero count] (h : start+count-1 < n) :
    sum_successive_terms s start count h = (sum_successive_terms s start count h : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sum_successive_terms coeFunctionInt2Real
  simp

name: ones_add
statement:
lemma ones_add (b m n : ℕ) :
    ones b (m + n) = ones b m + Nat.ofDigits b ((List.replicate m 0) ++ (List.replicate n 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold ones; dsimp only
  rw [List.replicate_add, Nat.ofDigits_append, Nat.ofDigits_append]
  rw [List.length_replicate, List.length_replicate, Nat.ofDigits_replicate_zero, zero_add]

name: pigeonhole
statement:
lemma pigeonhole (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → Fin n) :
  ∃ a b : ℕ, a < b ∧ f a = f b

name: lemma_3
statement: lemma lemma_3 {a n : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hm : a % n = 0) : (∃ k : ℕ+, a = n * k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := exists_eq_mul_right_of_dvd (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hm)
  have hkp : 0 < k' := lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left' (hk' ▸ ha)
  exact ⟨⟨k', hkp⟩, hk'⟩

name: two_le_ten
statement: lemma two_le_ten : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 10
proof: := tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.mp rfl

name: one_lt_ten
statement: lemma one_lt_ten : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 10
proof: := tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.mp rfl

name: one_le_ten
statement: lemma one_le_ten : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 10
proof: := tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.mp rfl

name: prepend_one_pos
statement: lemma prepend_one_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < prepend_one n
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · simp [prepend_one]
  · rw [prepend_one]; norm_num

name: digits_len'
statement:
lemma digits_len' (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
      List.length (Nat.digits 10 n) = 1 + List.length (Nat.digits 10 (n / 10))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.digits_def' two_le_ten hn, List.length]
  exact add_comm _ _

name: prepend_one_div
statement: lemma prepend_one_div (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : prepend_one n / 10 = prepend_one (n / 10)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prepend_one, prepend_one]
  cases n with
  | zero => exact (Nat.lt_asymm hn hn).elim
  | succ n =>
    rw [digits_len' n.succ (Nat.succ_pos n)]
    rw [pow_add, pow_one, add_comm]
    rw [Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (Nat.succ_pos 9)]
    exact add_comm _ _

name: prepend_one_mod
statement: lemma prepend_one_mod (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : prepend_one n % 10 = n % 10
proof:
:= by
  rw [prepend_one]
  rw [Nat.length_digits _ _ two_le_ten (ne_of_gt hn)]
  lia

name: prepend_one_eq_append
statement:
lemma prepend_one_eq_append (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.digits 10 (prepend_one n) = (Nat.digits 10 n) ++ [1]
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h n' ih =>
  cases n' with
  | zero => simp [prepend_one]
  | succ n' =>
    rw [Nat.digits_def' two_le_ten (prepend_one_pos _)]
    rw [prepend_one_div _ (Nat.succ_pos n')]
    have hns : n'.succ / 10 < n'.succ := Nat.div_lt_self' n' 8
    rw [ih _ hns]
    rw [← List.cons_append]
    rw [prepend_one_mod _ (Nat.succ_pos _), Nat.digits_def' two_le_ten (Nat.succ_pos n')]

name: prepend_one_all_one_or_two
statement:
lemma prepend_one_all_one_or_two (n : ℕ) (hn : all_one_or_two (Nat.digits 10 n)) :
    all_one_or_two (Nat.digits 10 (prepend_one n))
proof:
:= by
 rw [prepend_one_eq_append, all_one_or_two]
 rw [all_one_or_two] at hn
 intro e he
 rw [List.mem_append] at he
 obtain he | he := he
 · exact hn e he
 · rw [List.mem_singleton] at he
   simp only [he, OfNat.one_ne_ofNat, or_false]

name: prepend_two_pos
statement: lemma prepend_two_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < prepend_two n
proof: := by norm_num [prepend_two]

name: prepend_two_div
statement: lemma prepend_two_div (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : prepend_two n / 10 = prepend_two (n / 10)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prepend_two, prepend_two]
  cases n with
  | zero => cases Nat.lt_asymm hn hn
  | succ n =>
    rw [digits_len' n.succ (Nat.succ_pos n)]
    lia

name: prepend_two_mod
statement: lemma prepend_two_mod (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : prepend_two n % 10 = n % 10
proof:
:= by
  rw [prepend_two]
  rw [Nat.length_digits _ _ two_le_ten (ne_of_gt hn)]
  lia

name: prepend_two_eq_append
statement:
lemma prepend_two_eq_append (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.digits 10 (prepend_two n) = (Nat.digits 10 n) ++ [2]
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h n' ih =>
  cases n' with
  | zero => norm_num [prepend_two]
  | succ n' =>
    rw [Nat.digits_def' two_le_ten (prepend_two_pos _)]
    rw [prepend_two_div _ (Nat.succ_pos n')]
    have hns : n'.succ / 10 < n'.succ := Nat.div_lt_self' n' 8
    rw [ih _ hns]
    rw [← List.cons_append]
    rw [prepend_two_mod _ (Nat.succ_pos _), ← Nat.digits_def' two_le_ten (Nat.succ_pos n')]

name: prepend_two_all_one_or_two
statement:
lemma prepend_two_all_one_or_two (n : ℕ) (hn : all_one_or_two (Nat.digits 10 n)) :
    all_one_or_two (Nat.digits 10 (prepend_two n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [prepend_two_eq_append, all_one_or_two]
  rw [all_one_or_two] at hn
  intro e he
  rw [List.mem_append] at he
  obtain he | he := he
  · exact hn e he
  · rw [List.mem_singleton] at he
    right; exact he

name: factor_ten_pow
statement: lemma factor_ten_pow (k : ℕ) : 10 ^ k = (2^k) * (5^k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]
  | succ k' ih => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, pow_succ, ih]; ring

name: even_5_pow_plus_one
statement: lemma even_5_pow_plus_one (n : ℕ) : 2 ∣ 5 ^ n + 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero
  rw [Nat.add_mod, Nat.pow_mod]
  norm_num

name: ones_and_twos_aux
statement:
lemma ones_and_twos_aux (n : ℕ) :
  ∃ k : ℕ+, (List.length (Nat.digits 10 (2^n.succ * k)) = n.succ) ∧
             all_one_or_two (Nat.digits 10 (2^n.succ * k))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    use 1
    norm_num [all_one_or_two]
  | succ pn hpn =>
  obtain ⟨pk, hpk1, hpk2⟩ := hpn

  /-
    Adding a 1 or a 2 to the front of 2^pn.succ * pk increments it by 2^pn.succ * 5^pn.succ or
    by 2^{pn.succ+1} * 5^pn.succ, in each case preserving divisibility by 2^pn.succ. Since the
    two choices differ by 2^pn.succ * 5^pn.succ, one of them must actually achieve
    divisibility by 2^{pn.succ+1}.
  -/

  obtain ⟨t, ht : ↑pk = t + t⟩ | ⟨t, ht : ↑pk = 2 * t + 1⟩ := (pk : ℕ).even_or_odd
  · 
    rw [← two_mul] at ht
    have hd : 2 ^ pn.succ.succ ∣ prepend_two (2 ^ pn.succ * ↑pk) := by
      rw [prepend_two, factor_ten_pow, hpk1, ht]
      have hr : 2 * (2 ^ pn.succ * 5 ^ pn.succ) + 2 ^ pn.succ * (2 * t) =
                   2 ^ pn.succ.succ * (5 ^ pn.succ + t) := by
        repeat rw [pow_succ]; ring_nf
      exact Dvd.intro (5 ^ pn.succ + t) hr.symm
    obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := hd
    have hkp': 0 < k' := by
      cases k'
      · have hzz := prepend_two_pos (2 ^ pn.succ * ↑pk)
        lia
      · exact Nat.succ_pos _
    use ⟨k', hkp'⟩
    rw [PNat.mk_coe, ← hk']
    constructor
    · rw [prepend_two_eq_append]
      rw [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, hpk1]
    · exact prepend_two_all_one_or_two _ hpk2
  · 
    have hd : 2 ^ pn.succ.succ ∣ prepend_one (2 ^ pn.succ * ↑pk) := by
      rw [prepend_one, hpk1, factor_ten_pow, ht]
      have h5 : 2 ^ pn.succ * 5 ^ pn.succ + 2 ^ pn.succ * (2 * t + 1) =
            2^pn.succ * (2 * (2 * 5 ^ pn + t) + (5^pn + 1)) := by
        repeat rw[pow_succ]; ring_nf
      rw [h5]
      obtain ⟨k5,hk5⟩:= even_5_pow_plus_one pn
      rw [hk5]
      have h5' : 2 ^ pn.succ * (2 * (2 * 5 ^ pn + t) + 2 * k5) =
           2^pn.succ.succ * (2 * 5 ^ pn + t + k5) := by
        repeat rw[pow_succ]; ring_nf
      rw [h5']
      exact Dvd.intro (2 * 5 ^ pn + t + k5) rfl
    obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := hd
    have hkp': 0 < k' := by
      cases k'
      · have hzz := prepend_one_pos (2 ^ pn.succ * ↑pk)
        lia
      · exact Nat.succ_pos _
    use ⟨k', hkp'⟩
    rw [PNat.mk_coe,← hk']
    constructor
    · rw [prepend_one_eq_append]
      rw [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, hpk1]
    · exact prepend_one_all_one_or_two _ hpk2

name: cdist_if
statement:
lemma cdist_if (a b : Fin m) :
    cdist a b = if a.val ≤ b.val then b.val - a.val else b.val + m - a.val
proof:
:= by
  show (b.val + m - a.val) % m = _
  split_ifs with h
  · have e : b.val + m - a.val = (b.val - a.val) + m := by lia
    rw [e, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by lia : b.val - a.val < m)]
  · exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by lia)

name: shift_cdist
statement: lemma shift_cdist (a b : Fin m) : shift a (cdist a b) = b
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  show (a.val + (b.val + m - a.val) % m) % m = b.val
  rcases le_total a.val b.val with h | h
  · have e : b.val + m - a.val = (b.val - a.val) + m := by lia
    rw [e, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by lia : b.val - a.val < m)]
    have e2 : a.val + (b.val - a.val) = b.val := by lia
    rw [e2, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt b.isLt]
  · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h with hbeq | hlt
    · have e : b.val + m - a.val = m := by lia
      rw [e, Nat.mod_self, Nat.add_zero, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a.isLt, hbeq]
    · have e : (b.val + m - a.val) % m = b.val + m - a.val :=
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by lia)
      rw [e]
      have e2 : a.val + (b.val + m - a.val) = b.val + m := by lia
      rw [e2, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt b.isLt]

name: cdist_left_inj
statement: lemma cdist_left_inj {a b₁ b₂ : Fin m} (h : cdist a b₁ = cdist a b₂) : b₁ = b₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← shift_cdist a b₁, ← shift_cdist a b₂, h]

name: cdist_pos
statement: lemma cdist_pos {a b : Fin m} (h : a ≠ b) : 0 < cdist a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [cdist_if]
  have hab : a.val ≠ b.val := fun e => h (Fin.ext e)
  split_ifs with h2 <;> lia

name: cdist_add_of_lt
statement:
lemma cdist_add_of_lt {a b e : Fin m} (h : cdist a b < cdist a e) :
    cdist a e = cdist a b + cdist b e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cdist_if] at h ⊢
  have ha := a.isLt; have hb := b.isLt; have he := e.isLt
  split_ifs at h ⊢ <;> lia

name: arc_rotate
statement:
lemma arc_rotate {a b e : Fin m} (hab : a ≠ b) (h : cdist a b < cdist a e) :
    cdist b e < cdist b a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cdist_if] at h ⊢
  have ha := a.isLt; have hb := b.isLt; have he := e.isLt
  have hab' : a.val ≠ b.val := fun e' => hab (Fin.ext e')
  split_ifs at h ⊢ <;> lia

name: wrap_eq_of_mem_arc
statement:
lemma wrap_eq_of_mem_arc {y x p : Fin m} (hpy : p ≠ y) (h : cdist y p < cdist y x) :
    wrap p y = wrap p x + (if y.val < x.val then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < cdist y p := cdist_pos (Ne.symm hpy)
  simp only [cdist_if] at h hp0
  have hy := y.isLt; have hx := x.isLt; have hp := p.isLt
  have e1 : wrap p y = if y.val < p.val then 1 else 0 := rfl
  have e2 : wrap p x = if x.val < p.val then 1 else 0 := rfl
  rw [e1, e2]
  split_ifs at h hp0 ⊢ <;> lia

name: mem_avail
statement:
lemma mem_avail {used : Finset (Fin m)} {b : Fin m} :
    b ∈ avail c used ↔ c b = false ∧ b ∉ used
proof:
:= by
  simp only [avail, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

name: nb_eq_choose
statement:
lemma nb_eq_choose {used : Finset (Fin m)} {r : Fin m} (h : (avail c used).Nonempty) :
    nb c used r = Classical.choose (Finset.exists_min_image (avail c used) (cdist r) h)
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_left h

name: nb_mem
statement:
lemma nb_mem {used : Finset (Fin m)} {r : Fin m} (h : (avail c used).Nonempty) :
    nb c used r ∈ avail c used
proof:
:= by
  rw [nb_eq_choose c h]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_min_image (avail c used) (cdist r) h)).1

name: nb_min
statement:
lemma nb_min {used : Finset (Fin m)} {r : Fin m} (h : (avail c used).Nonempty)
    {q : Fin m} (hq : q ∈ avail c used) :
    cdist r (nb c used r) ≤ cdist r q
proof:
:= by
  rw [nb_eq_choose c h]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.exists_min_image (avail c used) (cdist r) h)).2 q hq

name: nb_eq_of
statement:
lemma nb_eq_of {used : Finset (Fin m)} {r b : Fin m} (h : (avail c used).Nonempty)
    (hb : b ∈ avail c used) (hmin : ∀ q ∈ avail c used, cdist r b ≤ cdist r q) :
    nb c used r = b
proof:
:=
  cdist_left_inj (le_antisymm (nb_min c h hb) (hmin _ (nb_mem c h)))

name: avail_insert
statement:
lemma avail_insert (b : Fin m) (used : Finset (Fin m)) :
    avail c (insert b used) = (avail c used).erase b
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_avail, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_insert, not_or]
  tauto

name: card_avail_insert
statement:
lemma card_avail_insert {b : Fin m} {used : Finset (Fin m)} (hb : b ∈ avail c used) :
    (avail c (insert b used)).card = (avail c used).card - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [avail_insert, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hb]

name: wraps_cons
statement:
lemma wraps_cons (r : Fin m) (rs : List (Fin m)) (used : Finset (Fin m)) :
    wraps c (r :: rs) used =
      wrap r (nb c used r) + wraps c rs (insert (nb c used r) used)
proof: := rfl

name: wraps_swap_pair
statement:
lemma wraps_swap_pair {r r' : Fin m} (hr : c r = true) (hr' : c r' = true)
    {used : Finset (Fin m)} (hcard : 2 ≤ (avail c used).card) :
    wrap r (nb c used r) + wrap r' (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') =
      wrap r' (nb c used r') + wrap r (nb c (insert (nb c used r') used) r) ∧
    insert (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') (insert (nb c used r) used) =
      insert (nb c (insert (nb c used r') used) r) (insert (nb c used r') used)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (avail c used).Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by lia)
  have hb1 : nb c used r ∈ avail c used := nb_mem c hne
  have hd1 : nb c used r' ∈ avail c used := nb_mem c hne
  have hne2 : (avail c (insert (nb c used r) used)).Nonempty := by
    rw [← Finset.card_pos, card_avail_insert c hb1]
    lia
  have hne2' : (avail c (insert (nb c used r') used)).Nonempty := by
    rw [← Finset.card_pos, card_avail_insert c hd1]
    lia
  have hb2 : nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r' ∈ avail c (insert (nb c used r) used) :=
    nb_mem c hne2
  
  have hlt_r : ∀ q ∈ avail c used, q ≠ nb c used r →
      cdist r (nb c used r) < cdist r q := by
    intro q hq hqne
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (nb_min c hne hq) (fun e => hqne (cdist_left_inj e).symm)
  have hlt_r' : ∀ q ∈ avail c used, q ≠ nb c used r' →
      cdist r' (nb c used r') < cdist r' q := by
    intro q hq hqne
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (nb_min c hne hq) (fun e => hqne (cdist_left_inj e).symm)
  by_cases hcase : nb c used r = nb c used r'
  · 
    
    have hb2e : nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r' ≠ nb c used r ∧
        nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r' ∈ avail c used := by
      have h := hb2
      rw [avail_insert] at h
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mp h
    have hlt_r'b1 : cdist r' (nb c used r) <
        cdist r' (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') := by
      have h := hlt_r' _ hb2e.2 (by rw [← hcase]; exact hb2e.1)
      rwa [← hcase] at h
    have hlt_rq : ∀ q ∈ avail c used, q ≠ nb c used r →
        cdist r' (nb c used r) < cdist r' q := by
      intro q hq hqne
      have h := hlt_r' q hq (by rw [← hcase]; exact hqne)
      rwa [← hcase] at h
    
    have hmin_b2 : ∀ q ∈ avail c (insert (nb c used r) used),
        cdist r (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') ≤ cdist r q := by
      intro q hq
      have hq' := hq
      rw [avail_insert] at hq'
      obtain ⟨hqne, hqmem⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hq'
      
      have e1 : cdist r (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') =
          cdist r (nb c used r) +
            cdist (nb c used r) (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') :=
        cdist_add_of_lt (hlt_r _ hb2e.2 hb2e.1)
      have e2 : cdist r q = cdist r (nb c used r) + cdist (nb c used r) q :=
        cdist_add_of_lt (hlt_r q hqmem hqne)
      have e3 : cdist r' (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') =
          cdist r' (nb c used r) +
            cdist (nb c used r) (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') :=
        cdist_add_of_lt hlt_r'b1
      have e4 : cdist r' q = cdist r' (nb c used r) + cdist (nb c used r) q :=
        cdist_add_of_lt (hlt_rq q hqmem hqne)
      have hmin : cdist r' (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') ≤ cdist r' q :=
        nb_min c hne2 hq
      lia
    have hd2_eq : nb c (insert (nb c used r') used) r =
        nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r' := by
      rw [← hcase]
      exact nb_eq_of c hne2 hb2 hmin_b2
    
    have hb1b : c (nb c used r) = false := ((mem_avail c).mp hb1).1
    have hr_ne_b1 : r ≠ nb c used r := by
      intro e; rw [e, hb1b] at hr; contradiction
    have hr'_ne_b1 : r' ≠ nb c used r := by
      intro e; rw [e, hb1b] at hr'; contradiction
    have hr_ne_b2 : r ≠ nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r' := by
      intro e
      have hb : c (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') = false := ((mem_avail c).mp hb2).1
      rw [e, hb] at hr; contradiction
    have hr'_ne_b2 : r' ≠ nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r' := by
      intro e
      have hb : c (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') = false := ((mem_avail c).mp hb2).1
      rw [e, hb] at hr'; contradiction
    have hb1_ne_b2 : nb c used r ≠ nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r' :=
      fun e => hb2e.1 e.symm
    
    have harc1 : cdist (nb c used r) (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') <
        cdist (nb c used r) r :=
      arc_rotate hr_ne_b1 (hlt_r _ hb2e.2 hb2e.1)
    have harc1' : cdist (nb c used r) (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') <
        cdist (nb c used r) r' :=
      arc_rotate hr'_ne_b1 hlt_r'b1
    have harc2 : cdist (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') r <
        cdist (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') (nb c used r) :=
      arc_rotate hb1_ne_b2 harc1
    have harc2' : cdist (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') r' <
        cdist (nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r') (nb c used r) :=
      arc_rotate hb1_ne_b2 harc1'
    
    rw [hd2_eq, ← hcase]
    refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
    have w1 := wrap_eq_of_mem_arc hr_ne_b2 harc2
    have w2 := wrap_eq_of_mem_arc hr'_ne_b2 harc2'
    lia
  · 
    
    have hd1mem : nb c used r' ∈ avail c (insert (nb c used r) used) := by
      rw [avail_insert]
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hcase, hd1⟩
    have hmin1 : ∀ q ∈ avail c (insert (nb c used r) used),
        cdist r' (nb c used r') ≤ cdist r' q := by
      intro q hq
      rw [avail_insert] at hq
      exact nb_min c hne (Finset.mem_erase.mp hq).2
    have hb2_eq : nb c (insert (nb c used r) used) r' = nb c used r' :=
      nb_eq_of c hne2 hd1mem hmin1
    have hb1mem : nb c used r ∈ avail c (insert (nb c used r') used) := by
      rw [avail_insert]
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hcase, hb1⟩
    have hmin2 : ∀ q ∈ avail c (insert (nb c used r') used),
        cdist r (nb c used r) ≤ cdist r q := by
      intro q hq
      rw [avail_insert] at hq
      exact nb_min c hne (Finset.mem_erase.mp hq).2
    have hd2_eq : nb c (insert (nb c used r') used) r = nb c used r :=
      nb_eq_of c hne2' hb1mem hmin2
    rw [hb2_eq, hd2_eq]
    exact ⟨Nat.add_comm _ _, Finset.insert_comm _ _ _⟩

name: wraps_perm
statement:
lemma wraps_perm {l₁ l₂ : List (Fin m)} (h : List.Perm l₁ l₂) :
    (∀ r ∈ l₁, c r = true) → ∀ used : Finset (Fin m),
      l₁.length ≤ (avail c used).card → wraps c l₁ used = wraps c l₂ used
proof:
:= by
  refine List.Perm.rec (motive := fun x y _ => (∀ r ∈ x, c r = true) →
    ∀ used : Finset (Fin m), x.length ≤ (avail c used).card →
      wraps c x used = wraps c y used) ?hn ?hc ?hs ?ht h
  · intros; rfl
  · intro a x y hp ih hred used hcard
    have hpos : 0 < (avail c used).card := by
      have hlen : (a :: x).length = x.length + 1 := rfl
      lia
    have hb : nb c used a ∈ avail c used := nb_mem c (Finset.card_pos.mp hpos)
    rw [wraps_cons, wraps_cons]
    have hcard' : x.length ≤ (avail c (insert (nb c used a) used)).card := by
      rw [card_avail_insert c hb]
      have hlen : (a :: x).length = x.length + 1 := rfl
      lia
    rw [ih (fun r hr => hred r (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hr))
      (insert (nb c used a) used) hcard']
  · intro a b l hred used hcard
    have ha : c a = true := hred a (by simp)
    have hb : c b = true := hred b (by simp)
    have h2 : 2 ≤ (avail c used).card := by
      have hlen : (b :: a :: l).length = l.length + 2 := rfl
      lia
    obtain ⟨hsum, hset⟩ := wraps_swap_pair c hb ha h2
    simp only [wraps_cons]
    rw [hset]
    lia
  · intro x y z hp1 hp2 ih1 ih2 hred used hcard
    exact (ih1 hred used hcard).trans
      (ih2 (fun r hr => hred r ((hp1.mem_iff).mpr hr)) used (hp1.length_eq ▸ hcard))

name: value_zero
statement: lemma value_zero : value 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [value]

name: value_add
statement: lemma value_add (c d : Multiset ℕ) : value (c + d) = value c + value d
proof:
:= by
  simp [value]

name: value_cons
statement:
lemma value_cons (n : ℕ) (c : Multiset ℕ) :
    value (n ::ₘ c) = (n : ℚ)⁻¹ + value c
proof:
:= by
  simp [value]

name: value_singleton
statement: lemma value_singleton (n : ℕ) : value {n} = (n : ℚ)⁻¹
proof: := by simp [value]

name: value_replicate
statement:
lemma value_replicate (t n : ℕ) :
    value (Multiset.replicate t n) = (t : ℚ) * (n : ℚ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [value, Multiset.map_replicate, Multiset.sum_replicate, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: value_nonneg
statement: lemma value_nonneg (c : Multiset ℕ) : 0 ≤ value c
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiset.sum_nonneg
  intro x hx
  simp only [Multiset.mem_map] at hx
  obtain ⟨n, -, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: value_sum
statement:
lemma value_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Multiset ℕ) :
    value (∑ m ∈ s, f m) = ∑ m ∈ s, value (f m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp [value]
  | insert a s ha IH => rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, value_add, IH, Finset.sum_insert ha]

name: cap_eq'
statement: lemma cap_eq' (k : ℕ) : cap k = (k : ℚ) * (1 - (2 * (k : ℚ) + 1)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cap, div_eq_mul_inv]; ring

name: cap_sub_one_le
statement: lemma cap_sub_one_le (k : ℕ) : cap k - 1 ≤ cap (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
  · subst hk; norm_num [cap]
  · have h1 : ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (k : ℚ) - 1 := Nat.cast_sub hk
    rw [cap, cap, h1]
    have h1q : (1 : ℚ) ≤ (k : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have h2k1 : (0 : ℚ) < 2 * ((k : ℚ) - 1) + 1 := by linarith
    have h2kp1 : (0 : ℚ) < 2 * (k : ℚ) + 1 := by linarith
    have key : ((k : ℚ) - 1) / (2 * ((k : ℚ) - 1) + 1) ≤ (k : ℚ) / (2 * (k : ℚ) + 1) := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ h2k1 h2kp1]
      nlinarith
    linarith

name: exists_mem_of_mem_sum
statement:
lemma exists_mem_of_mem_sum {s : Multiset (Multiset ℕ)} {a : ℕ} (h : a ∈ s.sum) :
    ∃ t ∈ s, a ∈ t
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp at h
  | cons x s IH =>
    rw [Multiset.sum_cons, Multiset.mem_add] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact ⟨x, Multiset.mem_cons_self x s, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, ha⟩ := IH h
      exact ⟨t, Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem ht, ha⟩

name: count_sum_filter_boxes
statement:
lemma count_sum_filter_boxes (k : ℕ) (c : Multiset ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    Multiset.count n (∑ m ∈ Finset.range k, c.filter (fun p ↦ p = 2 * m + 1 ∨ p = 2 * m + 2))
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range k,
        (if (n = 2 * m + 1 ∨ n = 2 * m + 2) then Multiset.count n c else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (∑ m ∈ Finset.range k, c.filter (fun p ↦ p = 2 * m + 1 ∨ p = 2 * m + 2))
        = ((Finset.range k).1.map
          fun m ↦ c.filter fun p ↦ p = 2 * m + 1 ∨ p = 2 * m + 2).sum from rfl,
    Multiset.count_sum]
  simp only [Multiset.count_filter]
  rfl

name: filter_boxes_add_pile
statement:
lemma filter_boxes_add_pile (k : ℕ) (c : Multiset ℕ) (hpos : ∀ n ∈ c, 0 < n) :
    (∑ m ∈ Finset.range k, c.filter (fun p ↦ p = 2 * m + 1 ∨ p = 2 * m + 2))
      + c.filter (fun p ↦ 2 * k + 1 ≤ p) = c
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [Multiset.count_add, count_sum_filter_boxes, Multiset.count_filter]
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · subst hn0
    have hcount0 : Multiset.count 0 c = 0 :=
      Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr (fun h ↦ absurd (hpos 0 h) (by lia))
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m _ ↦ ite_eq_right (by lia)), ite_eq_right (by lia), hcount0]
  · have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0
    by_cases hn2k : n ≤ 2 * k
    · have hm0k : (n - 1) / 2 < k := by lia
